reviews.decision_reason: normalize truncates the selected demand records to head(1) via an index_window containing only [0]. That drops otherwise allowed corpus identifiers, including records tied to exact handoff inspection and other capability-covered needs. This is behaviorally significant because downstream coverage and provenance receive only n06-r01, making missing demand evidence invisible even though the selected input contains more allowed records.
